title: Other remote viewing teams trained by Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle

tellings.quote: rumors about the fact that there was other teams of remote viewers being trained by uh by Pat Price and Joe McGonagal other than than put off.

plain: There were rumours that remote viewing, the claimed skill of seeing far-off places with the mind alone, was taught to more teams than the one people know about. A speaker named only as Jack raises this on an episode with the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais. He says Pat Price and Joe McMoneagle, two of the best-known remote viewers, were rumoured to have trained other teams besides the one linked to the physicist Hal Puthoff. If true, the psychic spying work would have been bigger than the record shows.
